summary.result: If factors such as changes in the types of livestock products, changes in the livestock self-sufficiency rate, and development of emission factors according to productivity improvement are considered, more accurate emission calculations will be possible.
summary.background: The livestock sector, producing 14.5 percent of anthropocentric GHG emissions, plays an important role in climate change (Gerber et al., 2013).
summary.method: In this case, GHG in the livestock sector decreased by 3.6 million tonnes CO₂eq compared to BAU (Business As Usual) GHG emissions.
